content: L’iman n Ibrahim
Min i ɣa nini xenni x Ibrahim, azeǧif n řejdud nneɣ, aqa yufa di arrimet nnes n weysum?
Minzi mařa Ibrahim tuɣa ittwasegged s řexdayem, aqa ɣares ccan, maca war iǧi ca ɣar AREBBI.
Minzi min qqarent Tira Iqeddsen? “Yumen Ibrahim di AREBBI uca ittwaḥseb as-dd man aya d tasegda.”
Wenni ixeddmen war d as tᵉttwaḥesseb ca řmunet x řeḥsab n arḍa, maca x řeḥsab n umarwas, minzi ttursen as-dd.
Maca wenni war ixeddmen, maca yumen deg Wenni ittseggaden imednab, aqa l’iman nnes ad as dd-ittwaḥseb d tasegda.
Am mammec inna Dawud ɛawed x sseɛd n bnadem wenni umi dd as iḥseb AREBBI tasegda břa řexdayem, umi inna:
“Sseɛd n yinni umi ittwaɣfar ixeṭṭan nsen, inni umi issduriy Netta ddnub nsen.
Sseɛd n bnadem umi war dd as iḥesseb ca AREBBI ddnub nnes.”
Ma sseɛd-a x yinni ittwaxetnen waha niɣ ɛawed x yinni war ittwaxetnen? S minzi neqqar: “L’iman n Ibrahim ittwaḥseb as-dd d tasegda!”
Mammec d as t-i-dd ittwaḥseb? Ma řami tuɣa s wextan niɣ mařa tuɣa břa axtan? War tuɣi s wextan, maca tuɣa břa axtan.

Minzi iksi axtan d řeɛřamet d ucemmiɛ n tsegda n l’iman nni ɣares umi t tuɣa břa axtan, ḥima ad yiři d jedditsen n marra inni yumnen waxxa nitni břa axtan, ḥima ad asen dd-ittwaḥseb l’iman d tasegda ɛawed.
Netta d jedditsen i yinni s wextan, maca war iǧi i yinni idewřen yumnen zeg wextan waha, maca ɛawed i yinni igguren deg iṣuraf n l’iman n jedditneɣ Ibrahim umi tuɣa břa axtan.
Minzi lwaɛd i Ibrahim u i zzariɛet nnes belli ad yiři d awrit n ddunect, war dd-ittis ca s Ccariɛa, maca s tsegda n l’iman nnes.
Minzi mařa inni zi Ccariɛa d iwriten, aqa l’iman ixessaren uřa d lwaɛd ibeḍřen.
Maɣar Ccariɛa tᵉttaru aɣḍab. Mani war teǧi Ccariɛa, war din iǧi uřa d aɛeddi n Ccariɛa.

S uyenni nettwasegged s l’iman, ixs ad yini s arḍa, maḥend ad yiři lwaɛd nican i qaɛ zzariɛet nnes, war iǧi i yinni iǧan zi Ccariɛa waha, maca ɛawed i yinni iǧan zi l’iman n Ibrahim, wenni d jedditneɣ n marra idneɣ,
am mammec tura: “Aqa ggiɣ cek d jedditsen i waṭṭas n řegnus!”, zzat i AREBBI Wenni zi tuɣa tumned, wenni itticen Tudart i imettinen d wenni ittřaɣan timesřayin i war iǧin axmi ǧan.
Waxxa iqḍeɛ as řayas, aqa yumen s usitem ad idweř d jedditsen i waṭṭas n řegnus am mammec tura: “Ammu i ɣa tiři zzariɛet nnec!”
L’iman nnes war tuɣi iḍɛef, umi iḥseb arrimet nnes temmut am tuɣa ɣares mya n iseggʷusa, u umi immut uɛeddis n Sara.
Netta war icekk ca di lwaɛd n AREBBI axmi s nneqṣ n l’iman, maca imḥeḍ di l’iman nnes, iwca aɛuǧi i AREBBI.
Tuɣa issen nican belli min zzayes tuɣa iwaɛd AREBBI, izemmar ad t igg ɛawed.
S uyenni ittwaḥseb as-dd l’iman d tasegda.
Maca war turi di ssibbet nnes waha, aqa ittwaḥseb as-dd l’iman nnes d tasegda,
maca ɛawed di ssibbet nneɣ, ḥima Netta ad aneɣ t-i-dd-iḥseb d tasegda, i neccin inni ittamnen deg Wenni i dd-issnekkaren Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ zi taddart n imettinen,
Yeccu Lmasiḥ wenni ittwasellmen di ssibbet n ddnub nneɣ uca ikkar-dd ḥima ad aneɣ isegged.
